reviews.note: Smoke going out of Poland into Russia, which is the reverse direction from the strike he has been calling.
War first, then the plague, with the black horse. The VwWt7-MQ0HU telling four days earlier holds first mention.
Belarus with a Russian flag joining Russia, Turkey named alongside.
Look around at the acceleration. Any news flow satisfies this, which is why it recurs so easily.
Japan drawn into an attack with the two Koreas.
He works out the geography aloud and apologises for not knowing the area, which is worth recording as how the detail gets fixed.
Adds boats, major ships and cargo to the Japan and South Korea picture.
Kim out of the basement again. He has appeared at foreign summits repeatedly since 2024, so this is close to already true.
Adds that the Warsaw front is not about land but about war itself and about currency.

Earliest telling, 30 July 2026, eight days before the FCeX9hLlWEk version. Here the 41st floor is attached to the president's towers rather than to a Central Park view, and the number is said as 30 41st, which is worth noting given he later reads 41 as the forty first president.
Adds Times Square, Boston and Chicago to the subway picture, in prayer form.
New claim. He names a carrier and a bank initial, then hedges the bank name immediately.
Same vision, the ATM half. Every machine at one bank black in a cyber attack.
He says it happened already. Cuba has had repeated nationwide grid collapses since October 2024, so darkness over Cuba is close to the base rate rather than a hit.

Claimed fulfilment with a real pre-commitment on the 17th, twelve days ahead. The caveat is that Japan averages one or two magnitude 7 events a year, and what he called was water heating up rather than a quake.
Seattle, Portland and British Columbia with thirty thousand dead, restated off the Japan event.
Shaking false religion, with false temples coming to the ground alongside the church, Israel and America.
Thousand year old temples contrasted with three hundred year old American churches, with the 7.1 in southern Japan cited alongside.
War drums, alongside Russia, black horse and a European uprising of war.
Red hats and a ground invasion from the north, conditioned on Israel striking Syria first.
Adds Mar-a-Lago as the target, which makes it far more checkable than the earlier tellings. Still conditioned on how America handles Israel.
Adds Kai as prominent in the vision and Eric as less so, given against a news report about Melania and Barron.
Patriot air defence and another aid package read as the France material he gave earlier.
Human sacrifice behind closed doors with children tied up, and watch Berlin.
Chinese beach enforcement drone footage shown as an example. A clip, not his own word.
New claim, and one of the few in the corpus that is a report of something already done to him rather than a forward call.

New claim, and the most self-undercutting thing in the batch: he calls words promising good days for America itching-ear words, having given reprieve-window-2026, reprieve-four-years and good-year-2024 himself.
Thirty thousand more North Korean soldiers reported, cited against his earlier train vision.
Adds the reasoning he attributes to the plan: untrained men pushed forward so trained soldiers are spared.
A clip of an official announcing an oil supply arrangement with Turkey. Not a claim he makes.
South America set up for a great revival, with Colombia named and a man with a beard.
Houston and Louisiana oil reserves as sabotage targets, tied to tipping the economy into a 1930s crash.
He says the acts passed and will pass in the same sentence, which covers both states and makes it unscoreable as given.
Tither's rights against the devourer. The condition puts any shortfall on the giver rather than on the claim.
Persecution in named cities driving Jews back to Israel, with gas prices as the pretext.
Adds Jeremiah 24 as the passage given over America, which is the good figs and bad figs chapter.
Names Detroit and Philadelphia and the mosque, and puts it around the midterms, which makes it datable.
New claim. Distinct from drone-swarms-worldwide by having a launch point and a target city.
New claim. Gives a motive rather than an event, which makes it hard to falsify.
Another thirty thousand requested, with a European world war attached as the consequence.
Claimed fulfilment on a Russian petrol station queue. The queue in the footage is not established as a mile, and Russian fuel shortages after refinery strikes were already widely reported.
New claim. A specific weapon class with a stated limitation, which is more checkable than most of the weapons material here.
Two angels making military personnel invisible. The mechanism claimed removes any possibility of checking it.
New claim. A specific tactical pattern, and he says the same plan was prepared for Israel.
Footage of burning oil facilities identified as Saudi. He says himself he is not sure the footage is recent, which is recorded rather than smoothed.
He is now asking the audience whether two hundred dollar oil will ever happen rather than asserting it. That is a softening of a standing claim and is recorded as such.
A clip of the president on the ballroom schedule and budget, played against the ballroom he says he saw.
Adds the ballroom to the wartime president legacy and a six month frame, and reprises the word pride.
Angels called around special forces for the day. Prayer, and unfalsifiable as put.
New claim. Tragic is left undefined, so almost any Russian escalation would be claimed.
New claim, and the earlier of the two tellings. He identifies the country by working out a letter B from a map rather than by knowing it.
Adds that Germany and Italy are faded while France and England act together.
Four men and four countries named, but he lists England and the United Kingdom as two separate entries, so the count does not hold.
A storm breaking into a war all over Europe with major alignments.
New claim, and the earlier telling. He corrects his own direction mid-sentence from west to east, which is worth recording.
